analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current Price ($686.65) vs SMA5/20/50 ($679.87/$685.42/$684.02) — Above SMA20, below SMA5/50, indicating mixed short-term trend.
· High position relative to SMA100/200 ($659.23/$640.90) — Maintaining medium-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (89.9%) + Current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (45.4→53.2) — Exited oversold, settled in neutral zone, weakening upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-1.4025→-0.7669) — Improving from weak convergence, trend reversal signal still faint.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $685.42) — Bandwidth narrowed to 3.36%, suggesting potential consolidation.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($679.73) — Based on SMA5 and Pivot PP.
· Swing Resistance ($689.10) — Approaching 5-day high and upper Bollinger Band.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Mixed Higher Low and Lower High) — Diagnosed as lacking directionality.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.25x 5-day average) — Movement accompanied by moderate strength.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation) — Maintaining a wait-and-see stance due to neutral RSI, improving MACD, but non-trending ADX.
